text.tspan: Share of the population defined as severely food insecure vs.
Both metrics indicate that someone does not get enough food (in terms of calories) to eat: these metrics should be strongly
correlated. Severe food insecurity is measured based on food security questionnaires among households.
Undernourishment is based on estimates of actual calorie intake across the population.

tspan.tspan: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (2025)
Where data for 2024 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2019 and 2023 is shown instead.
